task_completion.description: Agent opens and reads the dither_plan.txt file to obtain coordinates and requirements.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of ~/Documents/dither_plan.txt.

task_completion.description: Agent slews the telescope to the center position (RA 10.1411, Dec 12.3064).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Telescope control software showing the target coordinates or 'Leo I' as the current position.

task_completion.description: Agent captures at least 2 frames at the center position using the Luminance filter.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Imaging software showing exposure progress or a file browser showing at least two .fits or .jpg files in the /home/ga/Images/leo1/center directory.

task_completion.description: Agent slews to the North, South, East, and West offset positions specified in the plan.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots showing the telescope coordinates changing to match the North (Dec 12.3897), South (Dec 12.2231), East (RA 10.1468), and West (RA 10.1354) positions.

task_completion.description: Agent captures at least 2 frames at each of the four offset positions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: File browser or imaging logs showing at least 2 frames saved in each sub-directory: /north, /south, /east, and /west.

task_completion.description: Agent creates a final log summarizing the completed observations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text file or terminal output displaying a summary of the 5-point dither completion and file storage paths.

integrity.description: Agent used the observatory's GUI software for slewing and imaging rather than just manipulating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the telescope control and camera control graphical interfaces being interacted with.

integrity.description: Agent did not simply 'echo' the expected file structure into existence without running the imaging software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The imaging software's 'Exposure' or 'Status' bar showing active progress for each frame.

integrity.description: Agent manually entered or verified the specific coordinates from the dither plan rather than using a default 'Leo I' search result which might differ slightly.
integrity.visual_evidence: The coordinate input fields in the GUI matching the specific decimal values from the dither_plan.txt.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target is Leo I Dwarf Galaxy. Base coordinates (Center): RA 10.1411, Dec 12.3064. Offsets: North (Dec 12.3897), South (Dec 12.2231), East (RA 10.1468), West (RA 10.1354). Required filter: Luminance (L). Minimum frames per position: 2. Storage root: /home/ga/Images/leo1. The agent must use the GUI to perform slews and captures.
